quotes.text: Requirements are like nose hair: everyone has them, nobody wants to see them, and they keep growing.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: Ladybird ditching a bunch of self-developed libraries for production-grade ones (like SQLite or Skia) helped them immensely improve their browser. But I can't help but feel nostalgic at the original hacker spirit of LB+SerenityOS.
quotes.author: kvuj
quotes.source: Hacker News — Ladybird Is Now in Alpha
quotes.extraction_note: Clean build-vs-buy insight: swapping your clever hand-rolled things for boring production-grade libs is what actually ships. The nostalgia clause keeps it human.
